scope: Fifteen missing Canton civil-rights prisoners; fifteen individually documented custody records and two vital dates.

defendants.label: Ed Hollander, Report on Defendants in Canton, February4,1964: eyewitness trial notes distinguish verified charges from disputed additional libel allegation against Chinn and Hewitt.

events.label: SNCC, Chronology of Recent Events in Canton, February4,1964: individual dates, identities and convictions; Palmer arrested January28.

report.label: Edward S. Hollander, CORE field secretary, Report on Canton, February26,1964,pp.4–6: individually named defendants, sentences, actual release dates and two-day juvenile detentions.

story.label: Contemporary Canton Story, January24,1964: individual arrest dates and allegations before charges changed.

jan26.label: SNCC WATS, January26,1964: named Canton detainees and Merritt allegation; original scan reviewed.

feb6.label: SNCC WATS Canton, February6,1964: Watts explicitly bonded out today; other listed names are not collectively released by that sentence.

chinn.label: Becca Walton, University of Mississippi, Mississippi Encyclopedia: C.O.Chinn birth September18,1919 and death July19,1999; Canton movement identity distinguished from relatives.

prisoner.name: C. O. Chinn
prisoner.description: C. O. Chinn supported voter registration and the Canton boycott. He was jailed during the January 1964 crackdown.

cases.charges: Initially disturbing the peace; convicted of intimidating Easter Branch
cases.sentence: February 3, 1964: $500 fine and six months. Appeal release around February 6; approximate day not stored.

prisoner.aka: C.O. Chinn; CO Chinn; C. O. Chinn Sr.
